name: io.github.bjorngluck/piherder-mcp
title: PiHerder
description: stdio MCP adapter for the PiHerder token API — fleet summary, jobs, features, and jail files.

environmentVariables.name: PIHERDER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your PiHerder instance (no trailing path).

environmentVariables.name: PIHERDER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer API token. Prefer host env or the client's secret UI; most clients do not expand ${PIHERDER_TOKEN} inside JSON.
